[
  {"task_id":"obj-p2-2","params":{"prop":[0,0,9,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Height 1 horizontal lines become 5, height 2 L shapes and rectangles become 9, and height 3 rings, squares, and vertical lines become 7."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p2-3","params":{"prop":[0,0,9,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Height 3 squares, crosses, rings, and vertical lines become 7; height 1 and height 2 objects become 8."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p2-0","params":{"prop":[0,0,9,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Height 3 squares, rings, crosses, and vertical lines become 9; height 1 lines and singletons and height 2 squares and L shapes become 5."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p0-1","params":{"prop":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"One-pixel objects become 5, two-pixel and six-pixel objects become 8, while three-, four-, and five-pixel objects retain their original colours."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p0-2","params":{"prop":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Singletons become 5, three-pixel horizontal lines, vertical lines, and L shapes become 6, and the four-pixel square becomes 7; larger objects retain their colours."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p2-1","params":{"prop":[0,0,9,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Height 1 horizontal lines and singletons become 6; height 2 rectangles and L shapes and height 3 rings, squares, crosses, and vertical lines become 9."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p6-1","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Objects touching any grid border become 5, including the left ring and bottom square in demonstration 1; interior objects become 8, including the ring and six-pixel rectangle in demonstration 3."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p0-3","params":{"prop":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Two-pixel objects become 7, the four-pixel square and five-pixel cross become 8, and singletons, three-pixel L shapes, six-pixel rectangles, and eight-pixel rings retain their colours."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p5-1","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,9,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"The largest and smallest objects become 5; the middle-sized object becomes 9: size 3 between 2 and 4, and size 6 between 4 and 8 or between 3 and 9."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p3-3","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,9,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Width 1 vertical lines and singletons become 8, width 2 L shapes and horizontal pairs become 6, and width 3 squares, rings, and rectangles become 9."}
]
